# MCP tools: Tasks and boards

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 9 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `list_tasks`

Use this for a bounded, paged list of tasks, optionally filtered by project_id, process_id or status.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `TaskPageOutput` with `tasks` (array of TaskListRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 100 |
| `process_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `project_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `status` | string | no | one of `todo`, `in_progress`, `blocked`, `completed`; may be null |
| `unsorted` | boolean | no | default `false` |

## `get_task`

Get one owned task by its Sidekick UUID.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `TaskDetailOutput` with `task` (TaskDetailRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |

## `create_task`

Use this when the user wants a new task, standalone or under a Project or Process.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `contacts:write`.

Returns: `TaskOutput` with `task` (TaskRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `title` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `contact_ids` | array of uuid | no | up to 10 items; may be null |
| `description` | string | no | up to 10000 characters; may be null |
| `domain_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `due_at` | date-time or date | no | ISO 8601 date and time; ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `estimated_minutes` | integer | no | 1 to 12000; may be null |
| `not_before` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `priority` | string | no | default `"normal"`; one of `low`, `normal`, `high` |
| `process_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `project_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `tags` | array of string | no | up to 10 items; may be null |

## `create_tasks`

Use this when the user wants several new tasks at once, for example from a photo of a whiteboard or a list.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `CreateTasksOutput` with `count` (integer), `tasks` (array of CreatedTaskRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `tasks` | array of object | yes | 1 to 20 items |
| `tasks[].title` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `tasks[].due_at` | date-time or date | no | ISO 8601 date and time; ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `tasks[].priority` | string | no | default `"normal"`; one of `low`, `normal`, `high` |
| `tasks[].steps` | array of string | no | up to 10 items |
| `tasks[].tags` | array of string | no | up to 10 items; may be null |
| `domain_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `project_id` | uuid | no | may be null |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `update_task`

Update explicit fields of one owned task at its current version; retry-safe with the same idempotency key.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `TaskOutput` with `task` (TaskRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changes` | object | yes | Fields to change: omitted stays, null clears where allowed. |
| `changes.description` | string | no | up to 10000 characters; may be null |
| `changes.domain_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `changes.due_at` | date-time or date | no | ISO 8601 date and time; ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `changes.estimated_minutes` | integer | no | 1 to 12000; may be null |
| `changes.follow_up_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `changes.last_completed_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `changes.not_before` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `changes.priority` | string | no | one of `low`, `normal`, `high`; may be null |
| `changes.process_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `changes.project_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `changes.recurrence` | object | no | may be null |
| `changes.recurrence.frequency` | string | yes | one of `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `yearly` |
| `changes.recurrence.day_of_month` | integer | no | 1 to 31; may be null |
| `changes.recurrence.interval` | integer | no | default `1`; 1 to 12 |
| `changes.recurrence.until` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `changes.recurrence.weekdays` | array of integer | no | up to 7 items |
| `changes.status` | string | no | one of `todo`, `in_progress`, `blocked`, `completed`; may be null |
| `changes.tags` | array of string | no | up to 10 items; may be null |
| `changes.title` | string | no | 1 to 200 characters; may be null |
| `changes.waiting_on_contact_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `changes.waiting_since` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `complete_task`

Mark one owned task complete using its current version.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `projects:read`, `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `TaskOutput` with `task` (TaskRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

## `reschedule_tasks`

Use this when the user wants to move 1 to 20 tasks at once, for example to tomorrow, next week (Monday), a given date, or to clear the due date.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `RescheduleOutput` with `count` (integer), `tasks` (array of RescheduledTaskRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `items` | array of object | yes | 1 to 20 items |
| `items[].expected_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |
| `items[].task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `items[].when` | string or date | yes | one of `tomorrow`, `next_week`, `clear`; ISO 8601 date |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `get_work_board`

Use this for the status board: one bounded page of Work records in manual order, grouped into status columns.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`.

Returns: `WorkBoardOutput` with `columns` (Columns), `filters` (Filters), `manually_ordered` (array of string), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actionable` | string | no | default `"all"`; one of `all`, `now`, `later` |
| `archive` | string | no | default `"active"`; one of `active`, `archived`, `all` |
| `attention` | string | no | default `"all"`; one of `all`, `requested` |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `estimate` | string | no | default `"all"`; one of `all`, `estimated`, `unestimated` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 100 |
| `priority` | string | no | one of `low`, `normal`, `high`, `urgent`; may be null |
| `project_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `q` | string | no | up to 200 characters; may be null |
| `status` | string | no | one of `todo`, `in_progress`, `blocked`, `completed`; may be null |
| `tag_match` | string | no | default `"any"`; one of `any`, `all` |
| `tags` | array of string | no | up to 5 items; may be null |
| `waiting` | string | no | default `"all"`; one of `all`, `waiting`, `not_waiting` |
